message.content:
This editorial illustration is a magazine cover titled "TEMPO" in large red block letters. A dark-colored military helicopter is positioned centrally at the top, flying toward the viewer against a light sky. Below, a vast mountainous landscape unfolds with rolling hills in shades of green and yellowish-brown. Smoke or fire is visible on a distant ridge.

In the foreground on the left, a person with dark skin, wearing a yellow shirt and blue shorts, stands on a grassy slope with their back to the viewer, holding a rifle. In the center, a group of small figures in various colored clothing—including yellow, blue, and white—are seen running up a light-colored, rocky hillside.

Legible text includes "AMUK KIWIROK" in large white letters at the bottom right, followed by a paragraph in Indonesian. Other text mentions "Tommy Soeharto Melawan," "Hasil COP26 Glasgow," and "15-21 NOVEMBER 2021." A barcode and QR code are in the top right corner. The illustration uses a painterly style with visible brushstrokes and a muted color palette dominated by greens and earthy tones.
